traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Hypoxidaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins parallel or pinnate; blades linear or lanceolate; leaf rosettes basal; plants hermaphrodite; ovary inferior; stems herbaceous; flowers solitary, in racemes, in spikes, in heads or in umbels; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit capsule or berry; parts of each whorl 3; stamens 3 to 6; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.perennation.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Hypoxidaceae: how its perennial herbs last from year to year (character 25), coded often a corm, often a rhizome.
